title: Welcome to the RemiBello Bootcamp Blog
excerpt: News, tips, and updates from our free 15-day tech bootcamp in Agege-Dopemu — share this with someone ready to step up.
content:
Welcome to the official blog for the RemiBello Step Up 15 Days Bootcamp Summer.

# What you'll find here

Training tips for Prompt Engineering, Graphic Design, and Photo Editing — plus bootcamp announcements you can share with friends and family.

# Join us live

We run daily from August 1–15, 2026, 10AM–2PM at Shitta Street, Dopemu Agege, Aluminium Village.

Registration is free. Limited slots.

Use the share buttons below to spread the word on WhatsApp, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, or Telegram.
author: the RemiBello
